# Hershel Sigma AI

> Hershel is an AI dialer for high-volume outbound sales and appointment-setting teams. It is built on a proven open-source dialing engine, then rebuilt around AI: its own rep console, its own manager screens, and AI that runs dial pace, caller IDs and call notes. Made by Hershel Sigma LLC.

Hershel runs as a fully managed service, 24/7. A sales floor gets a predictive dialer whose pacing, number health and call notes run themselves, so setters stay on the phone and managers stop babysitting settings.

## What the AI does

- **Dialler Manager (AI dial-pace control):** reads live campaign stats every few seconds (drop rate, agent wait time, pause time, leads ready to dial) and adjusts the dial level so agents talk to as many people as possible while the drop rate stays under the target the floor sets.
- **The Shield (caller ID protection):** watches every outbound caller ID for spam flags and carrier refusals, pulls flagged numbers out of rotation, replaces them, and alerts managers. It also catches carrier-side congestion (channel-limit and calls-per-second refusals) that ordinary call records hide. Works with Twilio and Telnyx.
- **Closable (AI closer briefs):** transcribes the recording of every appointment-set call, writes a structured brief for the closer with AI, and posts it to the contact in GoHighLevel before the appointment.

## Who it is for

Outbound floors that live on contact rate: solar sales, home services and other high-volume B2C appointment setting.

## Pricing

One setup fee, then a flat monthly rate scoped to floor size and call volume. Quotes come from a demo: info@hershelsigma.ai

- [What is a managed dialer?](https://hershelsigma.ai/managed-dialer): what a managed dialer service includes, how it differs from self-run and seat-based cloud dialers, and the questions to ask a provider
- [AI dialer for solar](https://hershelsigma.ai/solar-dialer): what a solar appointment-setting floor needs from a dialer (pace, caller IDs, closer handoff, no double-booking) and how an AI dialer handles each
- [GoHighLevel dialer](https://hershelsigma.ai/gohighlevel-dialer): what calling GoHighLevel has built in (Web Dialer, Power Dialer), when a floor needs predictive dialing, and how Hershel works alongside GoHighLevel
- [Power dialer vs predictive dialer](https://hershelsigma.ai/power-dialer-vs-predictive-dialer): how power, parallel and predictive dialers decide when to dial, what each costs a floor in rep wait and upkeep, the three ways floors run predictive today, and which type fits which floor
- [ViciDial dial level](https://hershelsigma.ai/vicidial-dial-level): ViciDial's dial level and adaptive dial methods (RATIO, ADAPT_HARD_LIMIT, ADAPT_TAPERED, ADAPT_AVERAGE), the campaign settings that steer them, how ViciDial counts drop percentage (drops divided by answered calls) and how to read agent wait time
- [Spam Likely calls](https://hershelsigma.ai/spam-likely): why outbound calls show Spam Likely, Scam Likely or Potential Spam, which analytics company labels for AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon, how to check and register numbers (Free Caller Registry), how to request a review, and how floors keep caller IDs healthy
